description_en: Queries a list of agent groups
description_zh: 通过本接口，可以进行查询获取外呼组列表
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi cloud-list-agent-group --enterprise-id 7000002 --start 0 --limit 10 --group-name gpName --gno WH123 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloudListAgentGroup

parameters.help_en: The index of the first entry to return. The value must be greater than or equal to `0`. The default value is `0`
parameters.help_zh: 从第几条开始取；说明：大于等于0，默认0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: `1` to `1000`. Default value: `10`
parameters.help_zh: 需要取出的数据条数；说明：大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The agent group name used to filter the query results
parameters.help_zh: 外呼组名称；说明：以外呼组名称为筛选条件查询
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The agent group ID used to filter the query results
parameters.help_zh: 外呼组编号；说明：以外呼组编号为筛选条件查询
parameters.name: gno
